title: PersistentWeaponModel
description: Weapon model that persists across scenes and rooms, retaining state between transitions.
content:
PersistentWeaponModel

Weapon model that persists across scenes and rooms, retaining state between transitions.

Model

Schema

JSON
{
  "cooldown": 0.5,
  "maxAmmo": 30,
  "visual": {
    "sprite": "sprites/weapons/pistol",
    "scale": 1.0,
    "flipX": false,
    "flipY": false,
    "color": "#FFFFFF",
    "opacity": 1.0
  },
  "components": {},
  "persistId": "player_primary_weapon",
  "saveAmmoState": true,
  "saveUpgradeState": true
}

Description

The PersistentWeaponModel extends WeaponModel with persistence capabilities, allowing weapon state to be retained across scene and room transitions. This is essential for player weapons that should maintain their ammunition count, upgrades, and other stateful properties as the player moves through different areas of the game. The persistence is managed via a unique persistId that identifies the weapon in the save system.

Fields

NameTypeDescription
cooldownfloatTime in seconds between consecutive attacks. Inherited from WeaponModel.
maxAmmointMaximum ammunition the weapon can hold. Inherited from WeaponModel.
visualVisualModelThe visual properties of the weapon. Inherited from WeaponModel.
componentsDictionary<string, Object>Weapon-specific components. Inherited from WeaponModel.
persistIdstringA unique identifier used by the save system to track this weapon across scene transitions.
saveAmmoStateboolWhether to persist the current ammunition count across scenes. Default is true.
saveUpgradeStateboolWhether to persist weapon upgrade data across scenes. Default is true.

Example

JSON
{
  "cooldown": 0.8,
  "maxAmmo": 8,
  "visual": {
    "sprite": "sprites/weapons/shotgun",
    "scale": 1.3,
    "flipX": false,
    "flipY": false,
    "color": "#FFFFFF",
    "opacity": 1.0
  },
  "components": {
    "spread": { "pellets": 6, "angle": 30.0 },
    "reload": { "type": "single", "time": 0.5 }
  },
  "persistId": "player_shotgun",
  "saveAmmoState": true,
  "saveUpgradeState": true
}

Related

  • WeaponModel — Base weapon model that PersistentWeaponModel extends
  • VisualModel — Visual properties for the weapon
  • ProjectileModel — Projectile behavior for ranged persistent weapons
